title: Resource map
idea: Resource map: Geographic distribution and a synchronized list support resource selection
audience: People who need to locate resource within a dashboard surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic spatial layout through its locate resource priority and explicit commitment contract: Map presence is not proof of current availability
navigation: Resource map keeps the current locate resource context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Geographic distribution and a synchronized list support resource selection
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to locate resource; place determines operational choices
composition.priority: Map presence is not proof of current availability

imagery.role: Support the actual locate resource context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Offer list navigation equivalent to map selection
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the resource map structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no locate resource content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Map presence is not proof of current availability
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized locate resource content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Map presence is not proof of current availability
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active locate resource context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
